name: How much does new flooring typically cost per square foot in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does new flooring typically cost per square foot in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of new flooring in the Bay Area can vary significantly based on the material, installation complexity, and contractor rates. On average, you might expect to pay between $3 to $20 per square foot for materials, with installation adding another $3 to $10 per square foot. For example, basic laminate might be on the lower end, while high-quality hardwood or intricate tile work could be on the higher end. It's important to get a detailed quote that includes labor, materials, and any necessary subfloor preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: New flooring in the Bay Area typically costs $3-$20 per square foot for materials, plus $3-$10 per square foot for installation, varying by material and complexity.
